description: This script generates XML data models for device management, supporting BBF and HDM formats, by organizing supported data model entries, converting them into XML, and handling external JSON and repository references.

methods.name: pretty_format
methods.description: Formats an XML element into a pretty-printed XML string with indentation.

methods.name: organize_parent_child
methods.description: Organizes a list of data model entries into parent-child relationships based on 'type' and 'param' attributes.

methods.name: get_info_from_json
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information from JSON files for a given data model parameter, including description, enumerations, range, and list.

methods.name: generate_bbf_xml_file
methods.description: Generates a BBF format XML data model file from supported data model entries and external JSON info.

methods.name: generate_hdm_xml_file
methods.description: Generates an HDM format XML device type description file with device info and data model structure.

methods.name: generate_xml
methods.description: Main function to generate data model XML in specified format (BBF or HDM) based on input parameters.
